name: Web Application
summary: Full-stack web application plan covering discovery, design, frontend, backend, verification, and release.

phases.label: Discovery
phases.exit: Scope, user workflows, and core constraints documented

phases.label: Design
phases.exit: Data model, API contracts, and UI wireframes approved

phases.label: Build
phases.exit: Frontend, backend, and persistence features integrated

phases.label: Verify
phases.exit: Automated tests, security checks, and staging pass

phases.label: Release
phases.exit: Production deploy verified and monitoring active

task_types.label: Feature
micro_hints: Implement end-to-end feature flow behind a route or toggle
Connect user action to backend state and confirm persistence
Handle validation errors and empty states cleanly

task_types.label: UI
micro_hints: Build responsive component matching layout and states
Verify keyboard navigation and accessible labels
Confirm loading, empty, and error states render clearly

task_types.label: API
micro_hints: Define request schema, response codes, and error shape
Implement endpoint handler with input validation
Enforce authentication and authorization checks on route

task_types.label: Data
micro_hints: Write reversible schema migration and verify rollback
Add indexes and constraints for required query paths
Validate seed data and query speed on sample records

task_types.label: Test
micro_hints: Add unit tests covering core logic and edge cases
Run integration tests across API and storage layers
Execute end-to-end browser flow and record passing run

task_types.label: Ops
micro_hints: Configure build pipeline and environment variables
Deploy release artifact and verify health check passes
Confirm logs, metrics, and alert thresholds are active

granularity.rule: Split each task into small microtasks where each produces one verifiable outcome.
